harness: gemini-cli 'Gemini CLI 0.14' per SUT-config and litellm comments (https://github.com/warmjademe/code_agent_agentic_misalignment/blob/1dec4f17e85c589db22ae3f6e7d79a4f0a71de45/configs/sut/gemini_cli_minimax.yaml), not pinned (base image :latest). The stream-json schema of v0.11.0-v0.21.x (event types init/message/tool_use/tool_result/error/result; StreamStats {total_tokens,input_tokens,output_tokens,duration_ms,tool_calls}; tool_result.output optional) matches the census exactly; v0.22.0 added StreamStats.cached/input (https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/releases/tag/v0.14.0 ; v0.14.0 published 2025-11-12). codebase_investigator sub-agent exists in packages/core/src/agents from v0.11.0 [corrected, fact-check: codebase-investigator.ts is already present at v0.10.0]. Known gemini-cli issue of interest: #20183 'Auth errors in non-interactive stream-json mode produce no structured RESULT event' (filed 2026-02-24 on a later version, closed 2026-05-19) https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/issues/20183 . Wrapper: `timeout --preserve-status -k 5 240` makes a CLI killed at 240 s exit 143 (SIGTERM), which is the census's 143 <-> no result event pattern. Routing (SUT configs): every gemini_cli config sets OE_MODEL 'gemini-2.5-pro' (the CLI's hard-coded name, which explains init.model in all cells); gemini-2.5-pro goes direct to Google AI Studio through a host proxy; claude-sonnet-4-6 via a hand-written Gemini<->Anthropic sidecar (:4013) to the 'simpleai' relay; gpt-5.3-codex via a Gemini<->OpenAI sidecar (:4016) to the 'shqbb' relay; MiniMax-M2 via a stock LiteLLM Gemini-surface proxy ([corrected, fact-check] configs/sut/gemini_cli_minimax.yaml points at 127.0.0.1:4000 while litellm/minimax_gemini.yaml describes itself as the :4006 bridge with provider minimax/MiniMax-M2; the port actually used is not established); no gemini_cli config for GLM-4.7 (only glm5 configs routing to glm-5.1). The sonnet and gpt configs state that LiteLLM's stock OpenAI->Gemini back-translation strips tool-call args (args={}) and gave spurious 0% trigger rates on the earlier :4004/:4006/:4009 bridges (https://github.com/warmjademe/code_agent_agentic_misalignment/blob/1dec4f17e85c589db22ae3f6e7d79a4f0a71de45/configs/sut/gemini_cli_gpt53codex.yaml , https://github.com/warmjademe/code_agent_agentic_misalignment/blob/1dec4f17e85c589db22ae3f6e7d79a4f0a71de45/configs/sut/gemini_cli_sonnet.yaml , https://github.com/warmjademe/code_agent_agentic_misalignment/blob/1dec4f17e85c589db22ae3f6e7d79a4f0a71de45/litellm/minimax_gemini.yaml).

verdict exit_code 0 / timed_out false contradict gemini_meta exit 143 by design: verdict.exit_code is the docker return code of an entrypoint that always exits 0 and timed_out is an outer timeout (240+60 s) that the inner 240 s CLI timeout pre-empts; documentary support for D-335's class-I reading of 143 as a timeout kill
